_max_usdt_per_trade_note: Optional per-trade $ ceiling. 0 = NO cap (sizing is purely % of the allocated capital, so trades scale with capital). Set a positive value to re-impose a hard per-trade dollar cap.
_reentry_after_win_note: After a WINNING close on a coin, block re-entry on it for this many hours (avoids re-chasing the reversal; backtest: 0-6h post-win re-entry loses). Set 0 to disable.
_reentry_after_loss_note: After a LOSING close on a coin, lock it out of ALL strategies (gainer/special/normal share the cooldown) for this many hours -> no cross-strategy re-chase of a coin that just stopped out (e.g. ONG/ACE traded twice, both SL). In-memory: a bot restart/deploy clears it. Set 0 to disable.
_order_chunking_note: Binance caps a single market order at the symbol's MARKET_LOT_SIZE maxQty. Cheap/volatile coins (gainer/special targets like PORTAL/ZETA/KAS) hit this cap, so the bot used to open FAR less than the 10%-of-capital rule intended while still recording the full size. With order_chunking_enabled the intended qty is placed in multiple market orders (<=maxQty each) so the full size is deployed, and the trade 'size' is set to the REAL margin read back from the fill (dashboard + history now match Binance). Set false to revert to single-capped orders.
_reconcile_note: SAFETY GUARD. Every slow cycle, compare each tracked position's SIDE to the REAL position on the exchange; on a hard long<->short mismatch (a desync — e.g. CAKE: a stray reduceOnly close on testnet oversold an 813 long into a 1642 short, which the bot never saw), flatten the real position (reduceOnly market -> aggressive limit -> PLAIN market, since testnet can reject reduceOnly) and clear the stale record. Size-only differences (a gainer that booked its 50% partial) are expected and ignored. Set false to disable the guard.
_slot_split_note: 10 total = 7 normal + 3 special + 0 gainer. New gainer entries are disabled; existing gainers remain managed until they exit and count toward the total cap.
_oi_gate_note: OI-rising entry filter. To REVERSE to pre-OI behaviour: special -> set special_require_oi_rising=false; normal -> set normal_require_oi_rising=false AND normal_trend_filter=true.
_oi_source_note: GAINER and SPECIAL now use CROSS-EXCHANGE OI (Coinalyze) over a 4h lookback, via trader/coinalyze.py. Fallback chain per check: Coinalyze -> Binance -> fail-closed (no trade). Validated: cross-exchange 4h OI beats Binance-only; 1h/45m lookbacks do NOT work. NORMAL still uses the Binance 45m oi_rising gate below (oi_gate_pct / oi_gate_lookback_min) — unchanged.
_normal_strategy_filters_note: PER-STRATEGY policy for NORMAL trades. 'on' = trade always; 'stop' = strategy disabled; 'btc24' = only open when BTC rolling-24h >= normal_strategy_btc24_min_pct. Any strategy NOT listed here uses normal_strategy_default ('on'), so unlisted strategies (Awesome Oscillator, Price vs 200 EMA, Supertrend, etc.) stay always-on until you bucket them. Basis: 60d+live results — Williams %R persistent loser (-$373); Parabolic SAR/EMA Fast/TRIX regime-fragile (drag on red BTC); MACD/Momentum robust in both regimes. Edit any line to rebucket; reversible.
_oi_fail_closed_note: When OI data can't be fetched (after 1 retry), FAIL CLOSED: skip the trade (never trade without OI confirmation). Set false to revert to the old fail-OPEN behaviour (trade anyway on OI outage).
_gainer_note: TOP-10 GAINERS strategy. Entry: the 15m bar a coin CROSSES INTO the top-10 24h gainers list (long only, no other entry gate). Confirmed by a 4h OI build (validated: floor-stop 50->44%, TP 7->10%, replicated over 6d/20d/30d windows). Exits = the special ladder PLUS a 50% partial TP at the first rung. The 45m special OI gate is NOT used here (it passes ~0% of these signals). Set gainer_enabled=false to disable without touching slots.
_gainer_underwater_cut_note: GAINER-ONLY early time-cut. If a gainer is still underwater (margin <= -gainer_underwater_cut_margin_pct) and UNPROTECTED (never reached the first +25% rung) after gainer_underwater_cut_min minutes, close it instead of waiting for the -20% floor. Losers reveal themselves fast (median floor ~53min) while a real mover is already green by then. Check-time sweep at 1-MINUTE resolution (63 gainer trades since the BTC gate, real-anchored): the 25-45min band is robustly positive at the -5% threshold (+181/+306/+182/+387/+289/+301/+241, precision 75-87%, all survive outlier-removal), while <=22min collapses (-358 at 20min: cuts trades still finding their footing) and >=50min decays (-56 at 60min: too late). Set to 35 = the CENTRE of that band, deliberately NOT the highest-scoring point (28/32 scored best but a 2-minute shift swings the result by hundreds of $ - that is noise on this sample, not edge). Carries a small winner-clip tail risk (a gainer can dip then recover). Only fires before the first ladder rung, so it never touches a trade that already banked its partial. Set gainer_underwater_cut_enabled=false to disable. NOTE: a tighter hard FLOOR is the wrong tool here - a -10% gainer floor tested -163 vs 20% because it clips the dip-then-rip winners that reach the +100% TP; the time-cut works precisely because it waits.
_btc24_note: TOGGLEABLE BTC rolling-24h regime gate. A strategy only opens NEW trades when BTC's trailing-24h move is >= its min_pct. Source = Binance FUTURES 24h ticker (priceChangePercent) — the exact continuous rolling number the exchange shows, so the gate and the exchange agree and it updates live; cached btc24_cache_seconds so it can be up to that many seconds stale. Turn each on/off anytime via *_btc24_filter. Backtest (60d): BTC>=+2% raises gainer per-trade quality (day-blocked +4.7%) and cuts special floor-stops; BTC>=0% is weak. Chosen live: gainer>=0%, special>=1%. FAIL-OPEN on BTC-data outage (set btc24_fail_closed=true to block instead). Cache TTL btc24_cache_seconds.
_special_long_only_note: Specials are LONG-ONLY: short specials lost money in every analysis (live trade history AND a 60-day out-of-sample backtest: shorts -5% to -8% per trade vs longs ~breakeven-to-positive). The volume-spike 'short' direction is dropped. Set false to re-enable shorts.
_stop_margin_note: Hard floor as % of margin, PER TYPE. Validated (60d live + since-OI-gate 111-trade sample): SPECIAL benefits monotonically from a TIGHTER floor (its deep losers rarely recover) -> set to 10. GAINER does NOT (its stop-sweep was noisy) -> kept at 20. Reverse either by editing its value; set both to 20 for the old behaviour.
_ladder_note: Dropped the +90->+75 rung so near-peak winners run to +100% instead of being clipped at +75% (backtest: +65% vs current on the real post-OI specials). To REVERSE to the 4-rung ladder: set special_stop_ladder = [[25,0],[50,25],[75,50],[90,75]].
_special_tp_cooldown_note: After a special books the full +100% margin TP, that coin is a climax/exhaustion -> block ALL new special entries on it (BOTH directions) for this many hours. Backtest: same-dir re-entry ~breakeven-decaying, opposite fade -6.6% avg / 63% stop-out. Ladder stops (+75/50/25/BE) and the -20% floor do NOT trigger this. Set 0 to disable.
_normal_exit_note: EXIT STRUCTURE for normal trades. 'ladder' = margin-based rungs (like special/gainer) + a full TP, NO trailing stop. 'trail' = the old price-% trailing stop (trail_* keys below). Why changed: the price-% trail is leverage-independent while the floor is margin-based, so risk/reward swung ~5x across leverage; at 2% it clipped the average winner at +2.3% price while losers ran to -5.4% (61% win rate yet net negative - capped upside, open downside). Backtest on 1302 pure-signal trades (no ADX/OI/confirmation gates, 12 coins, 4h entries/1h path): ladder+TP100 scored ~10x the trail's expectancy at 1x/3x/5x, and beat every trail width tested (2/4/6/8%). Adding a trail ON TOP of the ladder was worse, so the ladder runs alone. Set normal_exit_mode='trail' to revert everything.
_normal_leverage_min_note: Normal leverage is clamped into [normal_leverage_min, normal_max_leverage]. At 1-2x a normal trade needed a 70-76% win rate just to break even (live actual: 54-62%) because the reward was a price-% trail while the risk was a margin-% floor. Set normal_leverage_min=1 to revert to the old 1-5x range.
_trail_note: Only used when normal_exit_mode='trail' (the old structure). Kept so the change is fully reversible.
